newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate Minority Leader Daeschle praises Fed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate Minority Leader Daeschle praises Fed.

text.p: Senate Minority Leader Tom Daschle, D-South Dakota, praised the Federal Reserve's decision to leave interest rates steady.

"A smart decision," Daschle told reporters. "There are indications the economy wasn't as strong as a little while ago," he added. Daschle said the rate hike would have been the equivalent of a 15 cents per gallon increase in the federal excise tax on gasoline.
